customisationOptions.option: Stay one or two nights at an Alexandria seafront hotel
customisationOptions.source: If the round-trip drive feels punishing, the same circuit pairs naturally with one or two nights at an Alexandria seafront hotel, which lets the city breathe and adds the Bibliotheca Alexandrina and the Greco-Roman Museum to the sequence.
